, Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an unnecessary and incorrect constraint by redefining “victories” to mean only “confirmed destroyed aircraft,” explicitly excluding “out of control” and balloons. The question simply asks for the number of victories of Albert Ball (Ernest Foot’s best friend), which is widely reported as 44. By changing the counting method, the Planner steered the process toward a lower figure (e.g., 43) and created a discrepancy, directly leading to the wrong solution.
